name: VO2 ramp trained 30
description: VO2max ramp, trained runner: 9.0 km/h, +0.5 km/h per minute to 12.0, then +1 grade level per minute. Aim for 8-12 min. See docs/treadmill/VO2MAX.md. Stop with the console STOP key at exhaustion. Needs --running-mode, handrail up.
